title: One document's extraction, written by the reading model
description: Every value is an object with the value as stated, the page it is on, a short verbatim quote from that page, and whether it was inferred. A field the source does not give is omitted or written as the string "not stated". The model never assigns confidence; sc-geo computes it at ingest.

packets.description: Packet files read for this result

reader.description: Who read it (model and session), free text

notes.description: Anything the reader wants a reviewer to know

surfaces.description: Optional. Elevation or depth of the top or base of a unit at one place

water_tests.description: Optional. One entry per water-sample result, field measurement or hydraulic-test value, linked to a well, boring or spring

rock_tests.description: Optional. One entry per rock specimen or core test result, linked to a boring or core and depth, or to an outcrop

value.description: As stated in the source, in the source's own words and units

page.description: Page number as labelled in the packet (=== PAGE n ===)

quote.description: Short verbatim text from that page that shows the value

inferred.description: true when the value was reasoned out rather than read directly

units.description: Measurement units when stated separately from the value (e.g. a table header)

table.description: true when read from a table or log

elevation_field.description: An elevation or depth: a number or the text as printed; units given separately are ft or m

boundary_field.description: Which boundary of the unit the surface is

surface_method_field.description: Measured in a boring or well, read from a contour map, interpolated between points, or stated in text

depth_reference_field.description: Whether interval tops and bottoms are depths below land surface or elevations

datum.description: Vertical datum of the elevation, as printed

depth.description: Below land surface, instead of an elevation

datum.description: As printed: NGVD 29, NAVD 88, sea level, land surface...

observation.description: Label of a boring or well in this result

observations.description: Labels of borings and wells shown

kind.description: Kind of site sampled or tested (a plain string, like an observation's kind)

observation.description: Label of the well, boring, core, spring or outcrop as printed (the label of an observation in this result when there is one)

location.description: Location of the site as printed, when the test row or text gives one

sample_id.description: Sample, specimen or lab number as printed

date.description: Sample or test date as printed

top.description: Top of the sampled or tested interval

bottom.description: Bottom of the sampled or tested interval

depth.description: A single sample or test depth, instead of top and bottom

datum.description: Vertical datum when depths are elevations, as printed

unit.description: Stratigraphic unit sampled or tested, as printed

aquifer.description: Aquifer sampled or tested, as printed

parameter.description: Parameter or constituent exactly as printed (pH; Chloride, dissolved; Transmissivity)

value.description: The result as printed, with a qualifier printed with it (<0.5, ND, 1,200 ft2/d)

units.description: Units as printed (column or table header); never guessed

qualifier.description: A remark printed apart from the value: <, >, ND, E

fraction.description: Dissolved, total, filtered or unfiltered, as printed

method.description: Field or laboratory method, or the kind of hydraulic test (pumping test, slug test), as printed

lab.description: Laboratory or agency that analyzed the sample, as printed

source_table.description: Table or figure the value is from, e.g. Table 3

kind.description: Kind of site sampled or tested (a plain string, like an observation's kind)

observation.description: Label of the well, boring, core, spring or outcrop as printed (the label of an observation in this result when there is one)

location.description: Location of the site as printed, when the test row or text gives one

sample_id.description: Sample, specimen or lab number as printed

date.description: Sample or test date as printed

top.description: Top of the sampled or tested interval

bottom.description: Bottom of the sampled or tested interval

depth.description: A single sample or test depth, instead of top and bottom

datum.description: Vertical datum when depths are elevations, as printed

unit.description: Stratigraphic unit sampled or tested, as printed

rock_type.description: Rock type of the specimen as printed

test_type.description: The test as printed (UCS, point load, Brazilian tensile, triaxial, slake durability, RQD, core recovery, unit weight, absorption, modulus, Poisson's ratio)

parameter.description: The quantity reported when a test gives several (Is(50), peak strength, tangent modulus)

qualifier.description: A remark printed apart from the value: <, >, E

specimen_dimensions.description: Specimen length, diameter or L/D as printed

specimen_condition.description: Moisture condition as tested (dry, saturated, as received), as printed

confining_pressure.description: Confining pressure of a triaxial test, as printed

standard.description: Method or standard as printed (ASTM D7012 method C, D2938, D5731, D3967, D4644)

lab.description: Laboratory that ran the test, as printed

source_table.description: Table or figure the value is from
